name: Sour Diesel
summary: **Sour Diesel** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] that emerged in New York City in the 1990s, reportedly first grown by a breeder known as Joe Murray around 1996. Its exact parentage is disputed: accounts describe it as a cross of Chemdawg and a Skunk variety, though some place a Mexican sativa in its background instead. It has since been distributed as clones and seed by numerous breeders.
